# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c34 P17](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0017), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie is a young student at Queen's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)_

## Personality

Josie possesses an aggravating, blunt, and scornful demeanor, often expressing pity or condescension toward others. She is confident in physical dares, such as walking board fences with natural skill and airy unconcern. She tends to make blunt or insensitive comments regarding people's appearances and origins.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)_

## Traits

- Aggravating  <sub>[v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>
- Defiant  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011)</sub>
- Skilled at walking board fences  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>
- Tactless  <sub>[v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>

## Abilities

- Walking board fences effortlessly  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## History

During a party hosted by Diana Barry, Josie participating in games of 'daring' with the local girls. After Jane Andrews failed a challenge, Josie successfully walked along the top of a garden board fence. When Anne Shirley downplayed the feat, Josie dared Anne to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, leading to Anne's fall and broken ankle. She later visited Anne during her recovery. Josie went on to attend Queen's Academy in town, where she boarded at the same place as Frank Stockley and visited Anne at her town lodgings.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)_

## Background by volume

- Lived in Avonlea prior to attending town for studies  <sub>[v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>

## Quotes

> I don’t believe anybody could walk a ridgepole. You couldn’t, anyhow.  <sub>[v1 c23 P9](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0009)</sub>

> Then I dare you to do it. I dare you to climb up there and walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry’s kitchen roof.  <sub>[v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011)</sub>

> I suppose you’re homesick—some people have so little self-control in that respect. I’ve no intention of being homesick, I can tell you. Town’s too jolly after that poky old Avonlea.  <sub>[v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>

- Comrade of — Classmate with whom she sometimes stops speaking.  <sub>[v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c34 P20](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0020)</sub>
